hooks.command: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cronk-transcript-hook.mjs"; curl -fsS 'https://cronk.tnrd.net/hooks/transcript.mjs' -o "$f.part" && mv "$f.part" "$f"; if [ -s "$f" ]; then CRONK_URL='https://cronk.tnrd.net' node "$f"; else echo "Cronk's Transcript hook: couldn't fetch https://cronk.tnrd.net/hooks/transcript.mjs" >&2; fi; exit 0

f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cronk-transcript-hook.mjs"; [ -s "$f" ] || { curl -fsS 'https://cronk.tnrd.net/hooks/transcript.mjs' -o "$f.part" && mv "$f.part" "$f"; }; if [ -s "$f" ]; then CRONK_URL='https://cronk.tnrd.net' node "$f"; else echo "Cronk's Transcript hook: couldn't fetch https://cronk.tnrd.net/hooks/transcript.mjs" >&2; fi; exit 0
